holiatlas-source-template-reference.modality: Population T1/T2 templates, synthesized WMn-like contrast and source-label cell boundaries
holiatlas-source-template-reference.title: Brain template regions in source MRI and exact cell boundaries
holiatlas-source-template-reference.caption: Inspect 332 present source-defined regions and all 868 retained components in paired orthogonal template planes and exact cell-boundary meshes. Eighteen named regions are absent. Sulcal labels are source-defined CSF territories, not traced sulcal centre-lines or complete gyral banks. WMn-like contrast was synthesized by the source authors. This processed population template is separate from SPL and patient anatomy; no cross-atlas registration or clinical completeness is implied.
